notes: ACCESS. crateandbarrel.me (Al Tayer Group-run UAE/GCC franchise of Crate & Barrel, on SAP Commerce Cloud / hybris, NOT the same platform as the US site c58.json) is live and open for business - title tag reads "Modern Furniture Store in Dubai & UAE | Crate and Barrel UAE", no closure/redirect notice, unlike the co-window Pottery Barn UAE/West Elm UAE precedents which had wound down. Genuinely independent from S.N. 58 Crate & Barrel US (crateandbarrel.com): separate SAP Commerce instance, separate category tree/codes, separate product catalog (UAE product codes end _CNB), served from api.crateandbarrel.me rather than the US site's Constructor.io/Akamai stack. Not a duplicate-company case. Direct fetch of category pages succeeded via curl_cffi chrome124 impersonation (no persistent Akamai-style block encountered this session, unlike c58). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (checked https://www.crateandbarrel.me/robots.txt - generic User-agent:* rules only block /cart, /checkout, /login, /search/*, /my-account, admin-style paths, none of which were touched). COUNTS. The frontend product-listing grid on this Next.js/React site is populated client-side by fetching the same public OCC REST API used here (api.crateandbarrel.me/rest/v2/cab/products/search) - confirmed by locating the identical "resultsLabel":"countResults" / "namespace":"productList" component wiring inside the server-streamed page HTML, meaning the API's pagination.totalResults IS the site's own reported count, not a separate/inflated index (unlike Constructor.io on the US sibling site). Verified exhaustively on Wall Mirrors: a single pageSize=100 category-filtered API call returned exactly 29 unique product codes, matching pagination.totalResults=29 and the unfiltered-search allCategories facet count. All qty values below are the API's query=:relevance:allCategories:<code> pagination.totalResults, each pulled with a fresh live request (not reused from the interrupted prior session's salvaged root_search.json facet dump, which was cross-checked but not solely relied upon since it truncates categories with count<4). Full category tree (550+ nodes) obtained from the unprotected /rest/v2/cab/catalogs endpoint, giving exact parent/child names and codes used to build canonical /en-ae/c/... URLs for every row. DUPLICATE/OVERLAP HANDLING (Rule: compare product-ID sets not names). Dropped as pure facet re-cuts after product-code overlap checks: "Grape Glasses" (46/47 codes already in Wall/Wine Glasses) and "Flutes" (12/12 codes already in Champagne Flutes) - both are an alternate-path duplicate of the Wine Glasses & Champagne Flutes branch; "Drink Dispensers" (both drink-dispensers-19517 and drink-dispensers-22488, 27/27 and 30/30 codes respectively already inside Decanters, Carafes and Pitchers) and "Pitchers" (12/16 codes inside the same node) - all three folded into the single canonical "Decanters, Carafes and Pitchers" (decanters-carafes-190, qty 65) node instead. Kept as separate rows despite partial overlap (Rule 0.6, genuine distinct site-published categories, not exact duplicates): Wall Decor (27) vs Wall Prints and Art (50) share 7 codes; Planters (43, Decor dept) vs Outdoor Planters (29, Outdoor dept) share 28 codes - both are legitimate room/department-context branches per the project's room-organization precedent, not a single listing under two URLs. EXCLUDED AS MIXED ROLL-UPS (inspected actual titles per Rule, dropped rather than padded). "Home Accents" (19 items: pet bowls, faux plants, plus items already counted under Planters/Vases) - non-decor items mixed with duplicates. "Outdoor > Accessories > Decor" (decor-15492, 19 items: mostly duplicate planters/lanterns plus outdoor textile pillows and a fireplace log holder) - merchandising grab-bag, not a clean taxonomy leaf. "Entryway Decor" (49 items: duplicates Wall Mirrors/Coat Racks/Display Shelves/Centerpiece Bowls/Vases/Picture Frames plus non-decor furniture like a coat tree and hall tree) - curated cross-category "shop the room" bucket, not a distinct product-type category. "Bath Accessories" (79 items, bath-accessories-1640) - genuinely mixed between decorative vanity items (soap dishes, trays, canisters, tissue box covers) and excluded bathroom storage/plumbing/textile items (trash cans, hampers, shower curtains, towel racks) with no clean site-side split between the two and no precedent for inclusion on the c58 US sibling; excluded in full as a judgment call, flagged below for reviewer awareness. "Fireplace Accessories" (7 items: outdoor fire pits/bowls, fireplace tools, a log holder, one screen) - furniture/hardware, not decorative accessories. "Stems & Branches" (101 items) confirmed 100% faux/artificial florals by Abigail Ahern on sampling - excluded per faux-plant rule alongside the already-obviously-named "Artificial Potted Plants & Trees". MIXED CATEGORIES SPLIT BY MANUAL TITLE COUNT (flagged, not a site-published number). "Candles" (candles-1330, 72 total) mixes scented and unscented with no separate site node for either (unlike the US sibling which has a dedicated unscented "Taper and Pillar Candles" page) - fetched the full list and hand-counted 32 unscented, non-holiday-themed candles; the 40 excluded were explicitly scented or holiday/seasonal-themed (Snowman, Christmas Tree, Pumpkin, Pinecone). "Curtains & Curtain Hardware" (curtains-curtain-hardware-14219, 24 total) is 21 textile curtain panels plus exactly 3 hardware items (2x curtain ring sets, 1x curtain rod set) - counted the hardware-only subset since curtain rods/tiebacks are explicitly in-scope decorative metal per Rule 0. EXCLUDED PER STANDARD RULES. All furniture (living room, dining, bedroom, home office, entryway, outdoor); all Rugs (by type/size/style); Bedding & Bath textiles/fixtures/storage; Home Fragrances and scented-candle-dominant SKUs; artificial/faux plants and florals; Wallpaper (not present in tree); Holidays & Gifts (Christmas, Easter, Mother's/Father's Day, all gift-by-X nodes); Sale/Clearance; Shop by Brand and Crate & Barrel Collaborations (designer/brand listing nodes); all named product-line "Collections" pages under Dinnerware Collections, Drinkware Collections, Serveware Collections, Popular Entertaining Collections (branded SKU groupings, not categories) except Acrylic Drinkware which is a generic product type despite sitting in the Drinkware Collections branch; Kitchen (all cookware/appliances/cutlery/bakeware/kitchen tools/storage/linens); Flatware and individual cutlery; Table Linens except Napkin Rings & Place Card Holders; Home Baskets (storage); all Crate & Kids furniture/bedding/rugs/toys/storage/gifts (only Kids Lighting, Kids Mirrors, Kids Wall Art & Decor and Kids Decorative Accents kept as decor per Rule 0). STATUS. ok, no access blockers encountered.
